notes.title: First Update
notes.content:
Hey guys, from the first wave of feedbacks I fixed everything I immediately can. Mainly:

- Better map system, it now shows van and player icons in real time
- Better level design, some objectives were hard to find for people
- Better save system, it now saves after every time a new main mission is started
- Pause menu (believe it or not i didnt think anyone would care if the game had this lol)
- Options menu (mouse sensitivity)
- Other quality of life improvements
